newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU tells Italy to reform pensions.
newsitem.headline: EU tells Italy to reform pensions.

text.p: The European Union's monetary committee on Wednesday urged the Italian government to engage in additional reforms to its pension systems, an EU source said.
The committee, which was reviewing Italy's economic convergence plan for monetary union, was generally encouraged by the efforts the governmment had made so far.
"It was well received," an EU official told Reuters.
Asked whether the committee recommended any specific measures, the official said "Yes. Structural reforms in the pension area."
